headline: Ukraine strikes strategic bridge in Crimea
standfirst: A major supply route for Russian forces in annexed territory is damaged after a targeted

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: Ukraine launched a missile and drone attack that caused a partial collapse of the Crimean Bridge.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: Ukrainian officials say the complex operation against this strategic target took weeks to plan.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: The bridge is a key link for Russia to move supplies into the territory it annexed from Ukraine.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Watch for the Russian response to this strike and the impact on their military logistics.

caption:
Ukraine has launched a missile and drone attack on the Crimean Bridge causing a partial collapse.

President Zelensky has hailed the operation as an unprecedented strike against Russian infrastructure. The bridge serves as a vital supply line for Russian forces in the annexed region. Military analysts are now watching how this affects the ongoing conflict.
